name: file_search
description: Search files by name pattern, content grep, size range, or modification date. Supports recursive directory search.
author: octopus

params.command: python3 -c "import os,re,glob,sys; pattern=sys.argv[1]; recursive=sys.argv[2]=='true' if len(sys.argv)>2 else True; files=glob.glob(pattern, recursive=recursive); print('\n'.join(files[:100]))" "{search_pattern}"
